item.title: ARCTIC Introduces Senza AI 370 Under Desk PC for AI Applications
item.description: ARCTIC has unveiled the Senza AI 370, a compact, under-desk PC designed to deliver high-performance computing for AI-driven workloads without the need for active cooling.

item.title: Sharkoon Launches S100 ARGB All-in-one Liquid Coolers
item.description: Sharkoon has introduced the S100 ARGB all-in-one liquid CPU cooler, now available in both black and white variants to suit a wider range of system aesthetics.

item.title: Geometric Future Launches MODEL 3 Chassis Ahead of China Debut
item.description: Geometric Future has unveiled its latest PC chassis, the MODEL 3 Prince Nezha, with a global debut scheduled to take place in China on 23 March.

item.title: Thermal Grizzly Launches Mycro Pro RGB CPU Water Blocks for AM5 and Intel Platforms
item.description: Thermal Grizzly has introduced two new CPU water blocks, the Mycro Pro RGB series, available for both AMD AM5 and Intel platforms.

item.title: ASRock Unveils Phantom Gaming PG27FFS2E Series Monitors with 240Hz Performance
item.description: ASRock has announced the launch of its latest Phantom Gaming monitors  the PG27FFS2E, PG27FFS2E-W, and PG27FFS1A.

item.title: GameSir Launches G7 Pro Dragons Dogma 2 Edition Controller
item.description: Inspired by the world of Dragons Dogma, GameSir has unveiled the G7 Pro Dragons Dogma 2 Edition  a next-generation controller designed for precision, power, and platform versatility.

item.title: FSP Introduces U590 E-ATX Chassis Featuring Full-Mesh Panels
item.description: FSP has unveiled the U590, a new E-ATX ultra tower chassis designed to deliver high-performance cooling alongside a bold, modern aesthetic.

item.title: ASUS Announces Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus Series Support on W880, Z890, Q870, B860 and H810 Motherboards
item.description: ASUS has announced full support for Intel Core Ultra 200S Plus Series processors across its Intel 800 series motherboard lineup, including W880, Z890, Q870, B860, and H810 models.

item.title: Super Flower Launches Thunder Panoramic PC Case with Angled Cooling Design
item.description: Super Flower has expanded its growing chassis lineup with the launch of the new Thunder mid-tower PC case, featuring a panoramic dual-chamber layout with angled cooling design.

item.title: CHUWI Issues Statement on CoreBook CPU Controversy, Offers Full Refunds, AMD to Take Action
item.description: Following earlier reports of CPU discrepancies in the CoreBook X and CoreBook Plus, CHUWI has issued an official response claiming a production error behind the issue.
